title: A useful pause
passage: The question was more interesting than I first thought. I took a moment before answering and chose an example from my own experience. The pause was part of the exchange. It gave me time to decide what would be useful to share.
steps: Read aloud once in your ordinary way.
Choose one feature or tool to explore.
Read the same text again with that one choice.
Save one observation and one real-life use.
reflection: What changed in effort or meaning?
